summary: Restoration pledges aim to afforest 7,000 hectares and reforest 3,000 hectares by 2030 with diverse, resilient, adapted species; these areas are equivalent to roughly 42% and 18% of the current 165 km2 forest cover, respectively. Conservation commitments include delineating 6,000 hectares of priority areas by 2025, a 50% increase in coastal and marine protected sites from a reported 128,000 hectares by 2030, management plans for 100% of marine protected areas by 2030, a 30% marine protected-area target, and conservation and monitoring plans for 100% of priority species by 2030. Agriculture establishes 3,250 hectares of new agroforestry systems by 2030, equivalent in area to about 14% of current agricultural area. Cross-cutting measures seek a 21% AFOLU emissions reduction relative to BAU by 2035 and priority habitat restoration and ecological corridors in at least three landscapes or islands; a -21% LULUCF change is also reported.
